messages:
alex: Hey — anyone seen a drop in prefetcher spans? Kibana logs show activity but Jaeger traces nearly empty, and we're getting alert spam from observability-bot about low-span-rate. cc @maria @sam

observability-bot: Alert: low-span-rate for service="prefetcher" (last 15m). Drop = 92%. Related dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc/traces-overview?orgId=1&var-service=prefetcher :rotating_light:

maria: Quick checklist: 1) Is OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT set in the pod env? 2) Are propagators configured (tracecontext|b3)? 3) Any recent sampler overrides? Try `kubectl exec -it <prefetcher-pod> -- printenv | grep OTEL`

sam: Also check collector config: https://git.redwood.internal/infra/otlp-config#L120 (sampling processor). For quick debugging flip sampler to `parentbased_always_on` in the collector and restart collector. Grafana trace panel: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/tx/prefetcher-traces?var-service=prefetcher

jess: FYI I pushed a tiny PR to bump sdk sampling to 1.0 for canary: https://git.redwood.internal/redwood/prefetcher/pull/482 — but don't merge until we confirm root cause. If you want to mute alerts for 30m use Alertmanager UI: https://alertmanager.redwood.internal/#/silences or run `./scripts/mute-alert prefetcher-low-span-rate 30m`

alex: Running the env check now. Output: `OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER=otlp; OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=https://otel-collector.infra:4317; OTEL_PROPAGATORS=tracecontext` — sampler env vars not present.

maria: Ok looks like SDK default is parentbased_traceidratio with 0.01 somewhere (we added global override last month). Check the startup flags of the deployment: `kubectl get deploy prefetcher -o yaml | yq '.spec.template.spec.containers[0].env'`

sam: If you want a temporary spike in traces, deploy a debug ref with `OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=always_on` and `OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG=1.0` and re-run a few requests. Remember to undo after.

alex: Thanks — running a debug rollout now, will post results. If we still see no spans after sampler bump we'll inspect collector TLS/auth against OTLP endpoint.

jess: ping me once you have logs, I can help with collector config and rollback mute.

alex: Thanks all :pray:
